prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [val2][反例] 行标题长于数据 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "考核指标" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 246px
  col 2: header "权重" · longest unbreakable word 33px · one-line width 33px
  col 3: header "目标值" · longest unbreakable word 33px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "实际值" · longest unbreakable word 45px · one-line width 48px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示各项考核指标的权重，并比较目标值与实际值。","reading":"读者先按行识别指标，再查看权重并横向比较目标值与实际值；各行应保持清晰的对应关系。","groups":["目标值和实际值是一组成对比较的数据列，应保持相近的视觉分量。","权重也是数值列，但作用是说明指标占比，而非与目标值比较。"],"keep_intact":["百分比、带比较符号的数值以及带“亿”的金额应尽量保持完整。","列标题应保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["较长的考核指标名称可在自然语义边界处换行，包括括号内的说明。","较长指标形成的行高可容纳同一行其他单元格的内容。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [169, 54, 67, 69] · table 360×252px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [185, 54, 54, 66] · table 360×275px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 36, 60] · column headers wrapped 2/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [145, 60, 76, 78] · table 360×275px · row heights [36, 60, 83, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"四个列标题和数值均保持完整；目标值与实际值宽度相近，便于横向比较。多数指标占两行，行高节奏较稳定。","problems":"第三项指标的“例”单独落在第二行，形成明显的孤字；前两项的括号说明也被拆开，阅读稍有停顿。","cause":"指标列宽169px，可用文字宽度148px，略不足以容纳第三项完整名称，也不足以让较长的括号说明完整排列。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"指标列较宽，第三项完整占一行，指标名称的阅读更顺畅。","problems":"“目标值”和“实际值”标题各占两行；首行的金额单位“亿”被挤到下一行，“≤ 12%”也被拆开，削弱了数值的完整性和比较效率。","cause":"指标列扩大到185px后，目标值列仅54px、实际值列仅66px；扣除21px的内边距和边框后，标题及部分数值没有足够空间。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"标题和数值均保持完整；目标值与实际值有充足空间，成对关系清楚。","problems":"第二项指标占三行，第三项断行也较生硬；数据列中的多余空白使指标列显得局促，行高节奏不均。","cause":"指标列仅145px，可用文字宽度124px；目标值和实际值列分别达到76px和78px，占用了指标名称更需要的宽度。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[174,54,65,66],"change":"以r0A为基础，将指标列增加5px，目标值与实际值列各收窄2至3px；保留标题和最长数值所需宽度，尝试消除第三项的孤字。"},{"name":"row-label-first","widths":[176,54,64,65],"change":"进一步扩大指标列，目标值和实际值列仍保持接近且各有足够空间容纳最长内容，检验指标换行能否更自然。"},{"name":"comparison-space","widths":[172,54,66,67],"change":"在r0A与更宽指标列之间取折中，给成对比较的数据列略多空间，同时改善指标名称的换行。"}]}
